snippet.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate - Mecha Sonic Moveset V2 trailer
snippet.description:
A V2 update for Mecha Sonic's moveset inspired by his appearance in Super Mario Bros Z made by Sintomatikoa and me.

Download link of the moveset: https://gamebanana.com/mods/495584

Included in this mod:
-Mecha Sonic on his own slot with a fully customized moveset
-Scrapnik Island's comic model as an alt costume
-8 alts in total (Mecha Sonic - Scrapnik - MK1 - Oxidized Copper - Knuckles -  Mecha Knuckles - Cooler (DB) - Inverted Scrapnik)
-UIs
-Voice and sound effect
-Effects
-One-slot victory theme
-One-slot announcer
-Classic mode

__________________

Mods in this trailer:
Shadow moveset: https://gamebanana.com/wips/73980
Vanishing Island stage: https://gamebanana.com/mods/438308
DBZ sounds for meteor moves: https://gamebanana.com/sounds/57702
World tournament stage: https://gamebanana.com/mods/433173
Vegeta moveset: https://gamebanana.com/mods/469216

Musics used in this trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xt1xZsv-NHc
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VaIEFxvIyRE

SMBZ has been created by @AlvinEarthworm thanks to him.
Old serie in HD: https://youtu.be/O6zkGU3-OVI
Reboot by the same author: https://youtu.be/HoHb38ROGVU
